comment: Mark sits in the merged band at the #8 sieve where three strokes are split by 2-3 px white slits (v 1703-1704 at u 1139-1145; v 1715-1717 at u 1131-1153). A circle of this sheet's size (outer r about 13) centred within a few px would put ring ink over those slits; no ring can be traced.
Mark is in an open white channel (u 1750-1773, v 1842-1849) between the solid line above and a dash below; the channel is open to the right, no ring outline around the mark.
White slot at the mark (u 2154-2163, v 2852-2870) is one of a regular series of dash gaps along the band (v about 2672, 2737, 2795, 2860, 2922, 2987; period about 62 px); no bulge or ring.
Solid average at u 1644 occupies v 1796-1807; Q (v 1800) and the P line (v 1802) are both inside that ink.
At u 1204 the solid average occupies about v 1713-1723 below the lower-curve dash (v 1699-1711); Q (1718) and the P line (about 1720) are both on the solid line's ink.

Curve ink (u 2155-2164) ends at the top edge of the #200 sieve dash (v 3155). (2160,3162) is at the bottom edge of that dash, 7 px past the curve's last visible ink; the only ink within 2 px, (2162-2163, 3162-3163), is the sieve dash meeting the frame.

At v 1435-1440 the merged curves straddle the frame: black u 677-696 with the frame at about 689-695 and curve ink at 677-688. Both samples (u 690) are within 2 px of that curve ink and below the top circle (ring bottom about v 1430).

Mark is on the lower curve's ink (top stroke of the band) but on the straight shallow run (slope about 0.16-0.19); the coarse-side bend of the lower curve is at about (750-800, 1610-1650), some 200 px back along the curve.
Same ink as item 006: the merged curves end at the top edge of the #200 sieve dash (v 3155); (2160,3162) is 7 px past it on the bottom edge of the sieve dash next to the frame.
Same as item 007: at v 1435-1440 curve ink lies at u 677-688 just left of the frame (689-695); samples at u 690 are within 2 px of it.

At v 1539-1540 the strokes are: frame 689-699, stroke A 703-714, stroke B 719-727. The upper (leftmost curve) is A; the frame is clean (white 695-703 at v 1541-1545) so P (691,1540) is on the frame with no curve under it, and the Q line at (723,1539) is on stroke B. Would put the upper at about (708,1539).
Same as items 007 and 010: merged curves straddle the frame at v 1433-1447 (black 677-696); samples at u 690 are within 2 px of curve ink left of the frame.

The average turns from the near-vertical coarse tail into its diagonal at about (812,1655); Q (818,1674) is at that bend and at the 45-degree point. P (932,1743) is about 140 px further on, where the curve is only slowly flattening.

The average's sharpest turn is where it goes vertical near (2195-2200, 2130-2150); Q (2199,2153) is there and on the average stroke. P (2158,2076) is about 85 px earlier where the slope is near 45 degrees and curvature is low.

Mark is at the left end of a 5 px white gap between the lower curve's dash (v 1868-1880) and the average/upper stroke (v 1887-1909); the gap continues right, no ring. Nearest ring-like hole is near (1610,1888), 26 px away.

Mark is on a 3-4 px white slit (u 2215-2218, v 2175-2183) that matches a #20 sieve-line dash gap (gaps at about u 2102, 2153, 2215) between the average and lower strokes. The merged ink (three strokes plus the lower circle near (2233,2177)) could hide an average ring, but none can be traced.

Ring centred about (2231,2904) on the #100 sieve sits on the leftmost stroke, which is dashed (gaps near v 2760, 2823, 2882, the last just above the ring). The continuous stroke at u 2237-2250 runs past the ring to v 2944, so the ring is not on the average.
Curve ink (u 776-787) continues through the 4.0 mm grid line (v 1519-1525) to v 1516; (784,1524) is on the crossing and (780,1514) is on or within 2 px of the curve's top end.

Lower curve leaves the near-vertical tail at about (826-835, 1666-1672); Q (824,1670) is at that bend on the band's right edge. P (1008,1758) is on the shallow run (slope about 0.3), well past the knee.

Lower curve's elbow is between its dash C2 (ending about (2215,2137)) and the vertical part from about (2213,2154); Q (2223,2152) is on that ink at the elbow. P (2163,2052) is on dash C1, about 100 px earlier on the diagonal.
Mark is in an open white channel (u 1378-1403 and beyond, v 1818-1826) between the 2.0 mm grid line (v 1808-1817) and a curve stroke below; no ring above or below the grid line.
As item 018: curve ink at u 776-787 crosses the grid line (v 1519-1525) and ends about v 1514-1516; both samples are on it.

Upper leaves the frame region and bends at about (800-820, 1655-1690); Q (846,1710) is on the upper's left edge near the 45-degree point just after the bend. P (931,1745) is about 100 px further along, in the slow flattening.

Upper's elbow falls in its dash gap between A2 (ends about (2172,2128)) and A3 (starts about (2183,2139)). P (2194,2149) is near it but on the average stroke (about u 2192-2205), 4+ px right of the upper's ink; Q (2154,2092) is on the upper but about 60 px up the diagonal. Would put it at about (2185,2145).
A circle centred at (2198,2179) would put ring ink across the white pocket at u 2194-2202, v 2184-2197 between the upper and average strokes; that pocket is white, so no circle is centred there.

The enclosed white hole (u 2228-2236, v 2816-2830) is a dash gap of the leftmost dashed stroke; its left wall is the 2% dotted grid line (u 2225-2229) and its bottom is the #80 sieve line. No ring wall, and no interior below the sieve line.
As item 018: both samples are on the curve ink that crosses the grid line at v 1519-1525 and ends about v 1514-1516.

Curve ink (stroke at u 2072-2082, separate from the frame at v 3143-3145) runs down to the #200 sieve line (v 3162-3169) and ends at its top edge. P (2081,3128) is 33 px before that on the 0.1 mm line; Q (2084,3175) is below the sieve line on frame raggedness where a dotted grid line meets the frame. First point at about (2078,3161).

FA-18 average bends gradually from shallow to vertical; curvature is highest in the last part of the bend (u 2010-2040, v 2010-2130). P (2038,2109) is on the average there; Q (1703,1785) is at the very start of the bend where curvature is lowest.

Mark is in a rectangular white slot (u 2072-2080, v 2868-2884) between a vertical curve stroke and the frame, the same shape as other dash-gap slots along the band (e.g. v 2806-2820, 2930-2945); no ring.
Same as item 028: the curves end at the top edge of the #200 sieve line (v 3162). (2084,3175) is 13 px past that, on frame edge raggedness where a dotted line meets the frame, not on curve ink.

As item 028: the merged curve ink ends at the top edge of the #200 sieve line. P (2086,3172) is on frame raggedness below the sieve line and Q (2081,3128) is 33 px before the end. First point at about (2079,3161).
The lower curve's dash ends where it turns near-vertical at about (2045,2062); P (2047,2064) is there. Q (1757,1784) is at the start of the broad bend where curvature is lowest.
Mark is on the left edge of the lower curve's dash near its end; the dash keeps its normal width, with a white channel just left (u 2019-2026) that a ring would cover. No ring or bulge.
As item 031: the sample (2086,3172) is below the #200 sieve line, 11 px past the curves' last visible ink (v 3161), on frame raggedness.
Upper turns to vertical at about (2020-2024, 2100-2130); Q (2023,2110) is on the upper there. P (1651,1786) is at the start of the broad bend where curvature is lowest.

Upper is the lowest stroke: dash S1 (1590-1640, 1770-1782) then dash S2 starting at u 1652 (v 1781-1789). P (1651,1786) is within 1 px of S2's start. The Q line at u 1651 (v about 1769) is in the merged lower/average stroke, about 15 px above the upper.

The average runs into its #200 circle (fitted centre about (2074,3210.5), outer r about 14.5, top at about v 3196). (2072,3196) sits on the circle's top outline where line and symbol share ink; borderline by 1 px.

Mark is on the lower curve's dash just before the #8 circle at about (1365,1755), but there is no knee there: the lower curve steepens gradually (slope about 0.7 to 1.0 across the circle). Its only clear knee is at the coarse end near (860,1455).

At the #4 sieve two merged circles sit on the average and lower; the lower one is centred about (888,1461), with interior remnants at (880-885, 1453-1459) and (892-895, 1466-1470). The mark is 5 px above that centre, inside the ring.
Mark is on the lower curve's dash where it crosses the 0.6 mm and #30 line; white directly above (v 2318-2324) and to the sides where a ring would be, and the dash keeps its normal width.

Right (lower) circle fitted centre about (2121.5,3211), outer r about 14.5. Both samples are on the short line segment entering it from the upper left (u 2105-2119, v 2187-2195), 4+ px outside the ring.
Mark is at the end of an upper dash where it meets the 0.3 mm grid line; a circle of this sheet's size (about 28-30 px) would put ink at u 1632-1635, which is white. No ring.
Three strokes here: upper dash A1 (from about (1838,2675) to (1870,2700)), solid average B (1865-1900 at v 2684), lower to the right. Q (1847,2683) is on the upper's dash A1, not the average.
P (1737,2620) is on stroke L (1728-1745 at v 2620), the continuation of the dash ending at (1712,2617), i.e. the upper's dashed line; the solid average is the stroke above it (1750-1793 at v 2620).
The lower is the top stroke: its dash at u 1570-1595 sits at v 2535-2546 above the merged band; Q (1573,2541) is on it. The P line at about (1573,2552) runs through the middle of the band (average).

Upper is the leftmost dashed line: dash L (551-565, 2236-2258, just beyond the frame) and dash N (565-588, 2268-2313) crossing the frame. (558,2247) is on L; (576,2296) is where N overlaps the frame (N ink 578-586 visible right of it), within 2 px.
Upper is the leftmost dashed stroke (pieces ending at (2003,2921) and starting at (2013,2933)); P (2027,2924) is on the right-hand merged ink next to the frame, about 18 px right of the upper's line.
The upper's dash on the band's left edge ends at about (1984,2858); P (2003,2861) is in the middle of the merged average/lower ink, about 13 px right of the upper's line.
Merged curves end at the top edge of the #200 sieve line (last curve ink v 3183, line v 3184-3189). (2174,3186) is inside the sieve line, 3 px past the last visible curve ink.

At the top end the merged curves overlap the frame (blob u 716-735 at v 1501-1507, band through the grid line at v 1508-1515); both samples are in that overlap, at the band's top row and on the grid-line crossing.

The lower (right edge of the merged band) turns fastest at about (2160-2166, 2175-2195), from about 72 to 80 degrees; Q (2158,2182) is there on the lower's ink. P (2143,2149) is about 35 px earlier at the inner edge of the lower's ink.
Curves end at the top edge of the #200 sieve line (last ink v 3183); (2184,3186) is in a small white hole just inside the sieve line, 3 px past the last visible curve ink.
As item 050: (2166,3186) is inside the #200 sieve line, 3 px past the curves' last visible ink at v 3183.

Upper is the leftmost stroke: its last dash D (u 712-720, v 1451-1486) lies just beyond the frame and its ink continues at u 716-724 at v 1501-1525. (717,1463) and (717,1453) are on D; (720,1512) is on that left ink where it crosses the grid line.
